newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's FIB30 stock index future hits new record.
newsitem.headline: Italy's FIB30 stock index future hits new record.

text.p: Italy's FIB30 futures contract on the Milan bourse's blue chip MIB30 stock index reached a new record high in early trading helped by Wall Street's record close overnight, dealers said.
The September FIB30 contract hit a new record of 23,400 in early trading and then a new high of 23,525 minutes later. It was up 2.05 percent at 23,480 at 0745 GMT.
